نبذة

Base & Boon is a modern, trend-setting salon that encompasses self-expression. Skillfully crafted and built for comprehensive escapism, Base & Boon vows to ensure every individual leaves feeling pampered, appreciated, and listened to, allowing individual beauty visions to come to life. Our dedicated team combines artistry and personalized care to transform your unique style into a stunning reality.

Base manicures, pedicures and BIAB gel builder services are complemented by friendly, professional attention, leaving clients with beautifully finished nails and an enjoyable visit.
